newsitem.title: USA: Florida Senate approves $20 mln of tax exemptions.
newsitem.headline: Florida Senate approves $20 mln of tax exemptions.

text.p: The Florida Senate approved a bill Thursday granting about $20 million of sales tax exemptions for various businesses and products, a legislative clerk said.

The bill (CS-SB1660) exempts items ranging from post-season college football tickets to gold bullion. One of the bigger tax breaks in the bill, worth about $3.2 million a year, would lift the six-cent sales tax for commercial airline parts.
The proposal now goes to the House.
Previously, the Legislature agreed to exempt internet services from taxation, worth about $10 million, and granted tax credits to companies that create jobs, worth another $10 million.
Altogether, they are expected to have granted about $40 million worth of tax exemptions during the annual legislative session that ends Friday.
